description: Northern Province - Appointed Hon. Canagasabapathy Viswalingam Wigneswaran as the Minister of Finance & Planning etc. and Hon. Pathmanathan Sathiyalingam as the Minister of Health & Indegenous Medicine etc, w.e.f. 23.05.2016
categorisation: This gazette contains both specific named individuals (Hon. Justice Canagasabapathy Viswalingam Wigneswaran and Hon. Dr. Pathmanathan Sathiyalingam) AND detailed portfolio responsibilities (e.g., "Minister of Finance and Planning, Law and Order, Lands, Social Services and Rehabilitation..." and "Minister of Health and Indigenous Medicine and Probation and Childcare Services"). This combination of people names with specific ministerial responsibilities makes it a Hybrid Gazette (Type 3) according to the classification rules.
